channel.title: Ofgem - Press releases
channel.description: Custom RSS feed for Ofgem press releases

item.title: Ofgem consults on proposals to reinforce gas import capability
item.description: Today, Ofgem has approved Interconnector Limited entering into an agreement, under its licence, with National Gas Transmission plc to reinforce gas import capability through the Great Britain-Belgium interconnector.

item.title: Ofgem launches biggest ever OFTO tender round for £3.5 billion Hornsea 3 offshore transmission link
item.description: Ofgem has launched what’s expected to be its largest ever tender round for the offshore transmission assets connecting Hornsea 3 - one of the world’s biggest windfarms - to Britain’s power grid.

item.title: Ofgem unlocks funding for major electricity grid upgrade while delivering over £60 million of consumer savings
item.description: Ofgem has greenlit a £642.1 million funding package for National Grid Electricity Transmission’s Bramford to Twinstead project in East Anglia

item.title: Ofgem appoints Tim Jarvis as Chief Executive
item.description: The Board of Ofgem has confirmed the appointment of Tim Jarvis as Chief Executive following a rigorous and competitive recruitment process.

item.title: Ofgem moves to free up grid capacity by tackling excess battery projects
item.description: Ofgem proposes to approve a new commitment fee to help clear the battery connections queue and free up capacity for viable projects.

item.title: Energy price cap will rise by 4% from October 2026
item.description: Ofgem has announced a 4% increase of the energy price cap for the period covering 1 October to 31 December 2026.

item.title: Ofgem Energy Redress Scheme supports one million customers with record £250 million funding
item.description: Ofgem's Energy Redress Scheme has received £250 million in funding, helping one million customers.

item.title: Ofgem acts to free up grid capacity by tackling speculative data centre projects
item.description: Our consultation on plans to tackle speculative data centre projects in Britain's electricity connections queue.

item.title: Ofgem boosts long duration storage to secure more homegrown energy for customers
item.description: Energy regulator Ofgem gives provisional green light to a new generation of energy storage to reduce Great Britain’s reliance on energy imports

item.title: ​​OVO agrees settlement in relation to Ofgem’s investigation of its monitoring of prepayment meter customers
item.description: ​​Ofgem has closed its investigation into OVO Energy for its process failures that could have put vulnerable prepayment meter (PPM) customers at risk.

item.title: Energy price cap will rise by 13% from July
item.description: Ofgem has announced a 13% increase of the energy price cap for the period covering 1 July to 30 September 2026.

item.title: Ofgem sets rules for 2028 to 2033 grid investment to meet growing electricity demand
item.description: Our press release on the rules for 2028-2033 grid investment.

item.title: British Gas agrees settlement in relation to Ofgem’s investigation of unfair treatment of prepayment meter customers
item.description: Ofgem has closed its investigation into British Gas on its treatment of customers who had a prepayment meter installed without their permission.

item.title: Great Britain gains edge in race to secure sought-after components as Ofgem greenlight early construction funding for key energy projects
item.description: Great Britain’s energy security and clean power ambitions have received a boost after Ofgem greenlit early construction funding for a series of large electricity transmission projects in Scotland.

item.title: Response to the Ofgem Review
item.description: Our response to the government's review of Ofgem.

item.title: Ofgem announces biggest shortlist of bidders since 2019 with offshore transmission assets for three major North Sea windfarms up for auction
item.description: Ofgem has today (Tuesday 24 March) announced it has shortlisted its biggest field of bidders since 2019.

item.title: Director resigns as energy supplier pays £525,000 for overcharging customers
item.description: A non-domestic energy supplier will pay £525,000 and its director has agreed to resign for serious and persistent mismanagement that led to customers being overcharged, Ofgem has confirmed today.

item.title: Ofgem secures £20 million redress payments from National Grid Electricity Transmission after licence failures at Harker 132kV substation
item.description: National Grid Electricity Transmission plc (NGET) has today (Wednesday 11th March 2026) agreed to pay £20 million into Ofgem’s Energy Industry Voluntary Redress Scheme.

item.title: Ofgem announces CEO Jonathan Brearley’s departure and transition plan
item.description: Ofgem Chief Executive Officer Jonathan Brearley will be stepping down from his role at the end of March to take up the position of Permanent Secretary at the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero.

item.title: Energy price cap will fall by 7% from April
item.description: The change amounts to a reduction of around £10 a month for the average household using both electricity and gas.
